_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No single upside or downside breaker is active and the 7-day base rate is a coil, so the score is expected to hold inside the current band.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly forwards HOLD/coil; narrative has no forward crypto phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays 47-58 and funding remains near flat while BTC chops without a range break
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks above 62 with funding and 30d momentum lifting together, or F&G slips under 46 as skew/dvol resolve into a spot selloff
